MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: Low volatility and broad participation with Vol: 17.3% and Breadth: 6/8 sectors positive. Market tone: strong bull, risk appetite elevated.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy & Chemicals leading with TRALT (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +10.86%) ABOVE TREND and GUBRF (1W: +12.00% | 1M: +13.33%) ABOVE TREND; Holding & Investment strong via SAHOL (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +7.35%) ABOVE TREND. Banking shows breadth leadership—AKBNK (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND and YKBNK (1W: +5.16% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom is lagging with KONTR (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND and TCELL (1W: -0.77% | 1M: +0.39%) CORRECTION. Retail & Food is soft with CCOLA (1W: -6.14% | 1M: -13.36%) BELOW TREND and MGROS (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -11.12%) BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TRALT (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +10.86%) ABOVE TREND; GUBRF (1W: +12.00% | 1M: +13.33%) ABOVE TREND; TRMET (1W: +10.15% | 1M: +3.81%) ABOVE TREND; EKGYO (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND; AKBNK (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
CCOLA (1W: -6.14% | 1M: -13.36%) BELOW TREND; TKFEN (1W: -5.83% | 1M: +45.92%) CORRECTION; KONTR (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND; MGROS (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -11.12%) BELOW TREND; AEFES (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -9.89%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest momentum: TRALT (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +10.86%) ABOVE TREND and GUBRF (1W: +12.00% | 1M: +13.33%) ABOVE TREND, followed by TRMET (1W: +10.15% | 1M: +3.81%) ABOVE TREND, EKGYO (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND and SOKM (1W: +6.41% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banks confirm the rally: AKBNK (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND, YKBNK (1W: +5.16% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND and GARAN (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +4.33%) ABOVE TREND; ISCTR (1W: +0.81% | 1M: -3.18%) is in RECOVERY — technicals support overweight on high-quality bank exposure.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Mixed heavy-industry picture: ASELS (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +12.00%) ABOVE TREND and TOASO (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND are constructive, while ARCLK (1W: -0.81% | 1M: -7.05%) BELOW TREND and VESTL (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -8.14%) BELOW TREND show dispersion — stock selection is key.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy is the clear leader: TRALT (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +10.86%) ABOVE TREND, GUBRF (1W: +12.00% | 1M: +13.33%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +10.15% | 1M: +3.81%) ABOVE TREND and OYAKC (1W: +6.03% | 1M: +12.39%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +27.89%) is in CORRECTION despite strong monthly gains.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Under RISK-ON, overweight cyclicals: Energy & Chemicals, select Construction/REIT and high-quality Banks; underweight Technology & Telecom and weak Retail names. Trim laggards (KONTR, CCOLA, MGROS) and rotate gains into names with confirmed momentum and earnings catalysts.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
TRALT (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +10.86%) ABOVE TREND for continuation on flows; TUPRS (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +27.89%) CORRECTION for earnings/ refining margins; AKBNK (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND for retail inflows; ASELS (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +12.00%) ABOVE TREND for defence sector momentum.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Energy & Chemicals for carry and margin news; Banking for credit flow and rate commentary; Construction & REIT for earnings and housing data — these sectors will likely lead headline moves.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch XU100 momentum around recent intramonth highs for continuation and the 20-day volatility regime flip if vol rises above ~25%; catalysts: domestic CPI, central bank commentary, oil price moves and major bank earnings. A volatility uptick or breadth deterioration are the primary triggers to reduce risk exposure.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-ON market with low vol (17.3%) and six sectors positive; Energy & Chemicals and Banks are driving the rally. Prioritize momentum leaders (TRALT, GUBRF, AKBNK, ASELS) and avoid deep losers in Tech and weak Retail; monitor macro catalysts for reversal risk.
